output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows the owner to mint additional tokens and assign them to any user account. This can lead to a situation where the token supply is inflated, causing a drastic devaluation of the token, and potentially allowing the owner to exploit users in a rug-pull attack.

The transferFrom function does not check for integer overflow, allowing a user to transfer more tokens than allowed by the sender. This can be exploited to grant arbitrary token balance to a target user.
The transfer function does not check for integer overflow, allowing a user to transfer more tokens than allowed by the sender. This can be exploited to grant arbitrary token balance to a target user.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing users to buy an unintended amount of tokens, potentially draining the contract of funds.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing users to sell an unintended amount of tokens, potentially draining the contract of funds.
